prompt:
Create a 30-second short-form ad/brand spot in bright pop electro EDM, voiceover-friendly (NO sung lyrics). Radio-polished, clean modern mix with a strong immediate hook and a stinger/button ending. Tempo 120 BPM, straight 4/4 groove, tonal center E major, simple catchy diatonic harmony.

Structure: start with the hook instantly at 0s (high-energy synth motif + punchy drums), fast build through the midsection with subtle rises and added layers (tight kick/snare, crisp hats, clean bass, bright plucks/leads), then land a clear, satisfying button ending at ~0:29–0:30. Keep the midrange uncluttered and leave clear space for voiceover from 0s onward (avoid busy lead lines competing with VO; use sidechain and arrangement gaps). Include a brief micro-break or filter-down moment around 0:15–0:18 to reset attention, then a final lift into the ending.

Brand-safe CTA intent (voiceover copy suggestion, not sung): 
“My Crazy Song—turn it up.”
“Bright, bold, and unforgettable.”
“Tap play and feel the rush.”
title: My Crazy Song
